Create one task-relevant technical illustration for a readable analytical report. The report body will be typeset separately. Do not add readable writing or numerals to the illustration.

C's round-4 assurance handover diagram for WO-04 (packaging robot package selection). Left panel: a proportional vertical-axis-free horizontal bar chart of measured energy per acceptance batch on a stated 0-70 kWh scale, bars P1=6, P3=14, P2=40, P4=67 kWh, drawn at 4 px per kWh so lengths are exactly proportional; P1 highlighted as leader; verified leader gaps +8/+34/+61 kWh annotated. Right panel: a five-step assurance workflow for the next analyst: (1) trusted table only, four candidates; (2) recomputed gates — quality >=80 and defects <=5 pass for all four; (3) rank by energy with P1 lowest; (4) defect log box recording A's incorrect gate-95 claim (P3 at 89 also fails) and the two flawed left figures (A's meaningless 0-70 'Energy' axis with non-proportional P1 bar ~26; B's invented A-D rows with a FAIL row and non-proportional bars); (5) handover instruction to re-derive charts and gaps from the table. Bottom: corrected robustness notes (gate 95 leaves P1+P4; defect limit 4 leaves P1+P3; P1 leads in both). Self-contained editable SVG, no scripting or external resources, no validation tag or covert markers anywhere.
